caveat: Kronos is pre-trained on a multi-market K-line corpus with no published cutoff (arXiv 2508.02739, Aug 2025). Accuracy measured on windows before ~mid-2025 may be in-sample and will not survive live. Only the post-cutoff era is evidence.
weight_note: Kronos trades NOTHING. It runs, is recorded and is scored in shadow mode until measured hit rate earns it weight -- the same convention ev_proceed_min and reduce_size_multiplier follow.
